title: Fine-Tuning and Assembled Laws
claim_tested: A model predicting changes in the fine-structure constant must respect isotope-based constraints.
design: Compare a proposed fractional change in alpha against a published conditional 95% bound; no raw-isotope re-estimation.
identification_limits: The bound is conditional on the source's restriction relating changes in other fundamental parameters
No likelihood, new confidence interval, or raw isotope analysis is supplied
Constancy after formation neither proves nor refutes assembled origins
No credible natural experiment identifies the creation of the universe or its constants

result.conclusion: A conditional late-time stability constraint; no experiment here identifies assembled origins.
